meta.title: GCSE Physics — equations and data
meta.note: There is no national booklet: each board prints its own equations sheet, and the boards differ. Provision shown here is taken from the sheets recorded in sources.yaml. AQA's 2026 sheet prints all 35 equations; Edexcel's equation list prints every equation; OCR's 2027 sheet prints every recall and select equation. Because no equation must be memorised, every equation is in the `given` group.

provenance.aqa: AQA Physics Equations Sheet, GCSE Physics (8463), for use in June 2026 only
provenance.edexcel: Pearson Edexcel GCSE Physics Equations List, May–June 2024 (1PH0); a 2026 list was not retrieved
provenance.ocr: OCR GCSE Physics A (J249) Equation Sheet, June 2027

meta.basis: DfE confirmed on 26 February 2026 that students do not need to memorise equations for GCSE physics or combined science for the lifetime of the current specifications, and Ofqual decided on 5 May 2026 that boards must keep providing the sheets and must not set questions answerable solely by transferring information from them. The recall/select appendices in the specifications predate the 2022 policy and are not the provision. AQA's and OCR's current sheets were read directly. Edexcel's exam-support page states an equation list is provided in the exam room; the only machine-readable list is the May–June 2024 one, so Edexcel's provision here rests on that document and must be re-verified when Pearson publishes a later list.
